33 of 34 tests pass. `test_delete_without_where_matches_all_rows` fails, and I left it failing on purpose.

That test expects `parse(lex("DELETE FROM t")) == DeleteStmt("t", Literal(True))`. `test_delete_with_and_without_where` in the same file expects `DeleteStmt("t", None)` for the same input. Both can't pass for one input. I followed the `minidb.types` docstring, where `DeleteStmt.where` is `None` when there is no WHERE clause. That also matches the assignment text. Both test files are read-only for me, so I couldn't resolve the conflict. One of those two tests needs to change.

The parser is in `minidb/parser.py`.
